import os
import random
import sys
from collections import deque

W = H = 80
VIEW = 21
START = (1, 1)
DOOR_POS = (77, 77)
WALL, FLOOR, DOOR = '#', '.', 'D'

    ("Bat", 16, 7),
    ("Skeleton", 25, 11),
    ("Sorcerer", 35, 16),
    ("Demon", 50, 22),
]


def read_key():
    """Blocking single-key read, cross platform. Returns lowercase char."""
    if os.name == "nt":
        import msvcrt
        ch = msvcrt.getwch()
        if ch in ("\x00", "\xe0"):
            ch = msvcrt.getwch()
            return {"H": "w", "P": "s", "K": "a", "M": "d"}.get(ch, "")
        return ch.lower()
    import termios, tty, atexit
    if not hasattr(read_key, "_init"):
        fd = sys.stdin.fileno()
        read_key._old = termios.tcgetattr(fd)
        tty.setcbreak(fd)
        atexit.register(termios.tcsetattr, fd, termios.TCSADRAIN, read_key._old)
        read_key._init = True
    ch = sys.stdin.read(1)
    if ch == "\x1b":
        ch2 = sys.stdin.read(1)
        if ch2 == "[":
            return {"A": "w", "B": "s", "C": "d", "D": "a"}.get(sys.stdin.read(1), "")
        return ""
    return ch.lower()
